no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented to or discussed by the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the original approval of JEVTANA KIT (cabazitaxel, NDA201023). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review states plainly that 'No Advisory Committee Meeting was held,' and the Medical Review confirms the application 'was not presented to or discussed by the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee.' The filing checklist records the reason as 'Expedited review; no contentious issues for AC review,' so there were no AdComm concerns that influenced the approval.
